shots.scene: COLD OPEN, EXTERIOR: house(g,t,cam,{room:'exterior'}) (H1's exterior option name) - the Hale house on a quiet street at night, cold blue moonlight, ONE window lit warm upstairs-left. Slow push camMove z 1.00->1.06, tiny handheld drift. Mrs. Hale's car pulls out of the driveway, its red tail-lights sliding off frame left (0.2-1.5 s); on 'Mrs.' (0.44 s) the porch light blinks off by itself. Unsettling detail: the lit upstairs window has a curtain that settles back as if just let go. hfx grain + vignette + cold grade, fade in from black (config fadeIn 0.5). Safe zone: faces/text above y 1440 and left of x 900.

shots.line: Hale pays you fifty dollars to watch the house tonight.
shots.scene: KITCHEN, early evening: house(g,t,cam,{room:'kitchen', lights:{lamp:1, hall:0.6}}); window moonlight cold blue, the counter lamp is the one warm practical. HERO (cast.js HERO: grey hoodie, dark ponytail, no sweatband; acting.js poses, idle(), blinkFlag 3.3 seed 7) at s 1.9 by the counter, left third, facing right, idle; a folded $50 bill and a set of house keys on the counter in front of her (draw locally). Headlights sweep across the window behind her on 'Hale' (0.17 s) as Mrs. Hale drives off. On 'fifty' (0.91 s) she picks up the bill (poseAt stand -> holdFront), gold '$50' chip pops beside the bill on 'fifty' (QUALITY_BAR 36, small, upper-left third). On 'tonight' (2.73 s) exprAt neutral -> worried, she glances up toward the ceiling (look up-left). Camera slow push z 1.02->1.08. Unsettling detail: the fridge door has a child's crayon drawing under a magnet but the kitchen has no high chair, no toys. Keep the wall clock out of frame or blurred (it says 11:10/11:40 later). Safe zone: faces/text above y 1440 and left of x 900.

shots.line: On the fridge, she left a note.
shots.scene: THE FRIDGE: house kitchen, camera low and slow-pushing toward the fridge (camMove z 1.0->1.12, x drifts right->centre). The note is under a magnet: horror.js note(g, x, y, s, {rules:0}) - folded handwritten paper, nothing readable yet. HERO (cast.js HERO: grey hoodie, dark ponytail, no sweatband; acting.js poses, idle(), blinkFlag 3.3 seed 7) enters from the left edge (s 1.9, back three-quarter), on 'note' (1.29 s) she reaches and slides it out from under the magnet (poseAt stand -> reach). exprAt neutral -> nervous on 'note'. Fridge light hum, cold moon spill from the window right; warm lamp rim on her left side. Unsettling detail: the magnet holding the note is a tiny plastic house with its upstairs window painted black. Clock still out of frame. Safe zone: faces/text above y 1440 and left of x 900.

NOTE INSERT: the note fills the upper 2/3 of frame, held in HERO's hands (grey hoodie cuffs visible, thumbs at the edges), warm lamp light from the left, blue shadow right. note(g, 540, 760, s, {rules:0}) shows the heading 'RULES' in Mrs. Hale's ink handwriting and four blank numbered lines '1. 2. 3. 4.'; on 'Four' (0.15 s) the numbers 1-4 ink in one after another (0.08 s apart) - do NOT show any rule text yet. Slow push z 1.0->1.05, paper trembles 1-2 px (her hands shake). Unsettling detail: line 4 sits right at the bottom edge, pressed hard, as if written by a different hand. hfx grain + vignette. Safe zone: faces/text above y 1440 and left of x 900.

RULE 1 REVEAL (fast): same note framing as the previous shot, tighter (z 1.12->1.16). note(..., {rules:1}) - on 'one' (0.35 s) Rule 1 writes on in ink: '1. Never open the basement door. Whatever you hear.' Ink bleeds slightly as it lands. Only rule 1 visible; lines 2-4 still blank. Optional: ruleTitle(g, t, 1, 'NEVER OPEN THE BASEMENT DOOR') is NOT used here (save it), the note is the hero prop. Lamp flickers once (hfx flicker 0.1 s) on 'Rule'. Safe zone: faces/text above y 1440 and left of x 900.

THE BASEMENT DOOR: house(g,t,cam,{room:'basement', knock:0}) - old wood door, slide bolt locked, a gap of total darkness underneath. Cold moonlight from a side window, a thin warm line of kitchen light on the floor from behind camera. Slow dread push straight at the door, camMove z 1.0->1.10 over the whole shot. HERO (cast.js HERO: grey hoodie, dark ponytail, no sweatband; acting.js poses, idle(), blinkFlag 3.3 seed 7) in the left foreground, over-the-shoulder (s 2.2, back of hoodie + ponytail, blurred slightly), still holding the note at her side. On 'basement' (0.99 s) she turns her head toward the door (look right). Unsettling detail: the darkness under the door 'breathes' (hfx breathing darkness on the gap only, very slow, 0.25 Hz). Dust motes in the moon shaft. Safe zone: faces/text above y 1440 and left of x 900.

WHATEVER YOU HEAR (hold, 2.7 s): giantFace(g, 420, 760, 320, {who:'HERO'}) - HERO's face, ponytail, grey hood edge, lit cold blue from frame right (rimSide 1, rimColor moon blue), warm lamp kiss on the left cheek. faceAt keys [[0,'neutral'],[0.19 s,'worried'],[0.69 s,'suspicious']] - eyes slide right toward the (off-screen) basement door on 'hear' (0.69 s), blinkAmt 3.4 seed 7. Behind her, out of focus: the basement door and the black gap under it. Camera creeps in z 1.0->1.06. Unsettling detail: a faint scrape sound is heard after 'hear', and the gap under the door goes a shade darker (something moved in front of it on the other side). Safe zone: faces/text above y 1440 and left of x 900.

RULE 2 REVEAL (fast): note close-up again (same layout), note(..., {rules:2}): rule 1 already there, on 'two' (0.33 s) rule 2 inks on: '2. If the hallway light goes off, don't touch the switch. Just wait.' Push z 1.10->1.14, hands tremble. Lamp light now a little dimmer than before (lamp 0.85). Unsettling detail: the word 'wait.' is underlined twice. Safe zone: faces/text above y 1440 and left of x 900.

shots.line: If the hallway light goes off, don't touch the switch.
shots.scene: THE HALLWAY SWITCH: house(g,t,cam,{room:'hallway', lights:{hall:1}}) - long hallway, one bare ceiling bulb (the warm practical, glow + slow 2 px sway), the wall switch at shoulder height on the right wall at x ~700 (keep it left of x 900). HERO (cast.js HERO: grey hoodie, dark ponytail, no sweatband; acting.js poses, idle(), blinkFlag 3.3 seed 7) at s 1.9 in the left third, walking in slowly (walkAlong) then stopping by the switch on 'light' (0.69 s); on 'off' (1.27 s) she lifts her hand toward the switch (poseAt stand -> reach, hand stops 30 px short) and on 'don't' (1.87 s) snaps it back (reaction('wince')), exprAt nervous -> scared on 'switch' (2.47 s). Camera slow push + slight drift right toward the switch. Unsettling detail: the switch plate has small dirty fingerprints around it, at a child's height. Moonlight from the far end of the hall where the stairs begin (dark). Safe zone: faces/text above y 1440 and left of x 900.

JUST WAIT (dread hold, 2.5 s, mostly silence after the words): HERO medium close (rig at s 2.6, chest up, left of centre), back pressed to the hallway wall, bulb overhead making a warm top light, cold blue fill from the stairwell side. exprAt scared; on 'wait' (0.38 s) she swallows (head dips 4 px) and holds her breath: idle() breathing amplitude goes to ~0 after 'wait'. Camera drift z 1.0->1.05, slow. Unsettling detail: in the soft-focus background at the end of the hallway, the bottom step of the stairs is visible and the bulb's light stops at it like a wall (hard light edge). Safe zone: faces/text above y 1440 and left of x 900.

RULE 3 REVEAL (fast): note close-up, now lying on the kitchen table under the monitor's faint green glow; note(..., {rules:3}) - rules 1-2 present, on 'three' (0.45 s) rule 3 inks on: '3. Keep the baby monitor on. All night.' HERO's fingertip (grey cuff) traces the line. Push z 1.12->1.16. Unsettling detail: the paper has a faint second set of writing pressed through from the BACK (mirror-image ghost of a line, unreadable) - this sets up the flip. Safe zone: faces/text above y 1440 and left of x 900.

THE BABY MONITOR: babyMonitor(g, 470, 820, 2.4, {level:0, static:0}) on the kitchen table (house kitchen, blurred behind; lamp warm left, moon right). HERO's hand enters from the left and clicks the power switch on 'on' (1.12 s): the power LED goes green, the level row flickers once green (level 0 -> 0.25 -> 0) and a short static breath (static 0.3 for 0.2 s). Slow push z 1.0->1.08. Unsettling detail: after it settles, the FIRST LED keeps twitching on/off faintly, though nobody upstairs is making a sound. Safe zone: faces/text above y 1440 and left of x 900.

ALL NIGHT (dread hold): house kitchen at night, lamp:0.7, the window black-blue. HERO (cast.js HERO: grey hoodie, dark ponytail, no sweatband; acting.js poses, idle(), blinkFlag 3.3 seed 7) sits at the kitchen table (pose 'sit', s 1.9, left third), hood up now, the monitor glowing green on the table beside her, the note folded into her hoodie pocket (corner sticking out). On 'night' (0.47 s) she pulls her sleeves over her hands and looks at the monitor, exprAt worried. Biscuit (creatures.js cat, purple collar, green eyes) sits on the counter in the right third (x ~760, cat s 1.8), her back to us, staring motionless off frame right toward the hallway and stairs; tail flick once at ~1.6 s, ears forward. Slow push z 1.0->1.07. Unsettling detail: the cat does not blink once (blinkAmt off for this shot only). Fridge hum. Safe zone: faces/text above y 1440 and left of x 900.

TEN PAST ELEVEN: the kitchen wall clock close-up (house kitchen clock option at 11:10), moonlight across its face, the second hand ticking. On 'Ten' (0.26 s) the minute hand clunks onto 11:10 exactly; gold-cream '11:10' chip pops small in the upper-left on 'eleven' (0.66 s) (QUALITY_BAR 36; horror palette: pale ink colour, not bright gold). Camera slow push z 1.0->1.06 and a slight Dutch roll 0 -> 2 deg. Unsettling detail: the reflection in the clock glass shows the hallway behind camera with the stairs - and a darker shape on the landing that is gone 0.4 s later (very low contrast, never readable). Tension music starts rising here. Safe zone: faces/text above y 1440 and left of x 900.

shots.line: Something knocks on the basement door.
shots.scene: SOMETHING KNOCKS: house kitchen, hero at the table from a lower angle, the open kitchen doorway and the basement door visible deep in the right half behind her (out of focus, the gap of darkness under it). HERO (cast.js HERO: grey hoodie, dark ponytail, no sweatband; acting.js poses, idle(), blinkFlag 3.3 seed 7) (s 1.9, left third, sitting). On 'knocks' (0.49 s) she freezes mid-sip of a mug (poseAt holdFront, mug stops at chin), on 'basement' (1.23 s) her eyes go to the door first (look right, lookToward), head follows 0.25 s later, exprAt worried -> scared on 'door' (1.57 s). Camera starts a slow push toward the basement door over her shoulder (camMove z 1.0->1.10, x drifts right). Unsettling detail: the slide bolt on the basement door is now visibly UNLOCKED (it was locked in the earlier door shot). Cut at the end lands on the first knock. Safe zone: faces/text above y 1440 and left of x 900.

THREE KNOCKS (cut lands on knock 1): house(g,t,cam,{room:'basement', knock:...}) - tight on the basement door, the gap underneath fills the lower third (keep it above y 1440). Three knocks from the other side at 0.00, 0.45, 0.90 s: drive `knock` 0 -> 1 -> 0 over 0.12 s on each, the door bulges 3-4 px, the slide bolt rattles, dust drops from the frame, and the thin line of light under the door is cut by something passing (shadow left->right after knock 3). 'Three times.' is spoken over knock 3 and after (0.90 s-1.16 s). Punch zoom 2% + 6 px shake on each knock, otherwise dead still. Cold moon light only. Unsettling detail: the knocks come from LOW on the door (knee height, a child's height) - the dust falls from there, not from the top. Safe zone: faces/text above y 1440 and left of x 900.

YOU DON'T MOVE (shock, fast): giantFace(g, 430, 740, 330, {who:'HERO'}) - lit only by the cold moon from the right (rimSide 1) and the green monitor glow from below. faceAt [[0,'shocked'],[0.55 s,'worried']] - eyes huge, no blink at all in this shot, sweat 1, a held breath: no breathing motion. On 'move' (0.55 s) one tear-bright glint in the eye (glint 0.4). Camera locked except a 1 px tremble (handheld at 0.3). Unsettling detail: on the right edge (x ~820), out of focus, the basement doorknob turns a quarter and stops. Safe zone: faces/text above y 1440 and left of x 900.

ELEVEN FORTY (time skip, fast): the same kitchen wall clock (house kitchen clock option 11:40), minute hand clunks to 11:40 on 'Eleven' (0.15 s), pale ink '11:40' chip on 'forty' (0.47 s). Light has changed: the lamp is now off (lamp 0), only moonlight and the green dot of the monitor reflected in the glass. Camera slow push z 1.04->1.08. Unsettling detail: the clock's second hand stutters backwards one tick at ~1.2 s. Safe zone: faces/text above y 1440 and left of x 900.

shots.line: The hallway light goes off. You wait.
shots.scene: HALLWAY LIGHT GOES OFF -> WAIT IN THE DARK (3.4 s hold): house(g,t,cam,{room:'hallway', lights:{hall:1 -> 0}}). HERO (cast.js HERO: grey hoodie, dark ponytail, no sweatband; acting.js poses, idle(), blinkFlag 3.3 seed 7) (s 1.9, left third) standing in the hallway, monitor clipped in her left hand (green LED), the switch on the right wall (x ~700). The bulb buzzes, flickers (flicker on from 0.6 s) and on 'off' (1.15 s) CLICKS fully dark (hall 0 in one frame): the frame goes to deep blue moonlight from the stairwell only, HERO a rim-lit silhouette (rim cold blue + the green monitor dot), never a black frame. exprAt scared on 'off'; on 'wait' (2.57 s) she squeezes her eyes shut and presses her back to the wall, hands clenched at her chest (poseAt -> holdFront), NOT touching the switch. Camera slow push. Unsettling detail: in the dark, hfx breathing darkness at the far end of the hall where the stairs start; Biscuit's two green eyes appear low at the foot of the stairs, glint, looking UP the stairs. Cut at the end lands on the light click back on. Safe zone: faces/text above y 1440 and left of x 900.

IT COMES BACK ON (cut lands on the click): same hallway, lights:{hall:1} snapping on at 0.0 with one flicker (0.05 s off at 0.15 s), warm bulb light floods the hall. HERO (cast.js HERO: grey hoodie, dark ponytail, no sweatband; acting.js poses, idle(), blinkFlag 3.3 seed 7) flinches (reaction('shock', t, 0)), opens her eyes, exprAt shocked -> worried on 'back' (0.76 s). Her eyes go to the switch: on 'on' (1.08 s) a slow push into the switch (camMove x right, z 1.0->1.12). Unsettling detail: the switch is now in the ON position although she never touched it, and there is a fresh small fingerprint on the plate. At the far end of the hall, the foot of the stairs, Biscuit sits staring up the stairs. Safe zone: faces/text above y 1440 and left of x 900.

shots.line: Can you come tuck me in?
shots.scene: [C is self-contained] Uses sets/house.js house(g,t,cam,{room, lights:{hall,lamp}, flicker, doorAjar, shape, hand}), sets/horror.js note/babyMonitor/hfx(grain, vignette, cold grade, flicker, static overlay, breathing darkness)/endCard, cast.js HERO + creatures.js cat; follow DEMO_house.js / DEMO_horror.js. Look: cold blue moonlight + one warm practical (the hallway bulb behind/below), deep blacks, film grain, vignette. [MONITOR] 'Can you come tuck me in?' (cut lands on the static key-up; near-silent music). Macro on the monitor: babyMonitor(g, 470, 800, 3.2, {level, static}) in HERO's hand (grey hoodie cuff, thumb on the side), HERO's frightened face soft-focus behind it, upper-left (giantFace r 220 at x 300, y 520, blurred, faceAt [[0,'worried'],[2.9,'shocked']], lit green from below). 0.00-0.70 s: static key-up (static 1 -> 0.4, LEDs jump to full and drop). The whisper runs 0.71-2.92 s (audio burst 49.26-51.47; words.json times are wrong here, use these): LED level follows the voice envelope (green -> amber -> red on the stressed words 'come' ~1.4 s and 'tuck' ~1.8 s, flicker between), static 0.3 under the voice, a faint scanline/interference overlay. After the whisper (2.92-3.71 s) the LEDs stay lit at one dim red bar that should be dark - something is still breathing into the mic. Camera: very slow push z 1.0->1.10. Safe zone: faces/text above y 1440 and left of x 900.
shots.notes: Monitor line audio: 49.26-51.47 s (global). Word timings for this line in words.json are off by up to 0.9 s; drive the LEDs from these numbers.

Warm hallway bulb light from below, the top of the stairs pure cold blue-black. HERO (cast.js HERO: grey hoodie, dark ponytail, no sweatband; acting.js poses, idle(), blinkFlag 3.3 seed 7) (s 1.7, back three-quarter, centre-left, stair-climbing pose: walkAlong on the incline, slow) climbs 3 steps from 0.0 to ~1.8 s, the monitor in her left hand (green dot). On 'halfway' (~0.60 s) she stops; on 'turn' (~1.94 s) she pulls the folded note out of her hoodie pocket and turns it over (pose holdFront, paper catches the warm light), exprAt worried -> nervous. Biscuit (cat, purple collar, s 1.8) sits on the bottom step in the lower-left foreground (above y 1440), seen from behind, staring UP the stairs, ears flat. Camera slow push up the stairs z 1.0->1.08, y drifts up. Unsettling detail: the door at the top is ajar and there is no light behind it. Line audio 52.41-55.23 s (words.json is ~0.3 s early here; the ~times in this text are corrected). Safe zone: faces/text above y 1440 and left of x 900.

shots.line: There are no kids in this house.

THERE ARE NO KIDS (the realisation): giantFace(g, 430, 720, 330, {who:'HERO'}) on the stairs, camera slightly above her, looking down at her face; warm hallway light from below (rimSide -1 warm), cold moon from above-right. faceAt [[0,'worried'],[0.29 s,'shocked'],[1.23 s,'shocked']] - on 'no' (~0.29 s) eyes widen and pupils shrink, on 'house' (~1.23 s) her eyes slowly roll UP toward the top of the stairs (look [0.3,-0.9]); no blink. shots.line: I can see you on the stairs.
shots.scene: [C is self-contained] Uses sets/house.js house(g,t,cam,{room, lights:{hall,lamp}, flicker, doorAjar, shape, hand}), sets/horror.js note/babyMonitor/hfx(grain, vignette, cold grade, flicker, static overlay, breathing darkness)/endCard, cast.js HERO + creatures.js cat; follow DEMO_house.js / DEMO_horror.js. Look: cold blue moonlight + one warm practical (the hallway bulb behind/below), deep blacks, film grain, vignette. [MONITOR] 'I can see you on the stairs.' + 0.6 s HOLD: low angle from behind HERO's shoulder looking UP the stairs: house(g,t,cam,{room:'stairs', lights:{hall:1, flicker:0.2}, doorAjar:0.45, shape:0 -> 0.3, hand:0 -> 1}). HERO (s 2.2, back of grey hoodie + ponytail, lower-left, above y 1440) frozen halfway up, monitor raised in her left hand: babyMonitor {static 0.4, level following the whisper 0.15-2.80 s of this shot (audio 60.90-63.55 global), red on 'see' (~0.91 s) and 'stairs' (~2.42 s)}, its LEDs throw red-green flicker up the wall. The door at the top is OPEN WIDER than in the earlier stairs shot (doorAjar 0.15 -> 0.45, continuity). In the black of the doorway a barely visible shape (shape 0.3 max, never readable) and on 'stairs' (~2.42 s) a small pale hand settles onto the top of the banister (hand 0 -> 1 over 0.5 s, low contrast). HERO turns her head up toward it (lookUp) on 'see'. Very slow push up the stairs z 1.0->1.12 for the whole shot; the final 0.6 s after the voice ends is a dead-still hold (no new motion except the hand's fingers curling once). The hallway bulb flickers once at the end. Safe zone: faces/text above y 1440 and left of x 900.
shots.notes: Monitor line audio 60.90-63.55 s (global); words.json squeezes all 7 words into 59.99-60.04, ignore it. Hold 0.6 s after 63.55 then hard cut.
